what: Ada closes S, then starts S2 and moves there. Bo writes a close of S that is itself a delete, then moves in S; and closes S2, where he holds no seat, then asks for a seat in S2. A close binds its author in its own session only: Ada's S2 move is admitted. A deleted close row counts for nothing, so Bo's S move, after it, is admitted and no equivocation (R18). A close counts only by a member of its own session, so S2 is not closed and Bo's ask after his close there is no equivocation either. S is closed by Ada's close, and nothing is reported (D151, D152, D153, R18).
